sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("builtin" IN (0, 1)), "user_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_edited" IN (0, 1)), "seed_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NULL, "project_types" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES templates (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "aspect_ratio" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_fields" TEXT NOT NULL, "ai_permissions" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_void_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES void_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "void_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_transcript" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary_spans" TEXT NOT NULL, "structure" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, "used_in_project_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "promoted_project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX void_items_created ON void_items (created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX void_items_type ON void_items (type)
CREATE INDEX void_items_status ON void_items (status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "slots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("builtin" IN (0, 1)), "user_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_edited" IN (0, 1)), "seed_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "runtime_proportion" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX slots_template_pos ON slots (template_id, position)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "beats" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "slot_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES slots (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "blocks" TEXT NULL, "say_show" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX beats_project_slot_pos ON beats (project_id, slot_id, position)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("builtin" IN (0, 1)), "user_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_edited" IN (0, 1)), "seed_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "when_to_use" TEXT NOT NULL, "effect" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, "sources" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "frames" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "beat_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beats (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "strokes_path" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail_path" TEXT NULL, "aspect_ratio" TEXT NULL, "shot_size" TEXT NULL, "angle" TEXT NULL, "movement" TEXT NULL, "lens_feel" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, "block_id" TEXT NULL, "character_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference_images" TEXT NOT NULL, "shot_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shots (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX frames_beat_pos ON frames (beat_id, position)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "snapshots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "proposal_id" TEXT NULL, "restored_from_snapshot_id" TEXT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proposals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_transcript" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary_spans" TEXT NOT NULL, "changes" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_void_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES void_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "rejected_to_void_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES void_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "snapshot_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES snapshots (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX proposals_project_status ON proposals (project_id, status, created_at)
CREATE INDEX snapshots_project_created ON snapshots (project_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_queue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_void_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES void_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ai_queue_status_retry ON ai_queue (status, next_retry_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "characters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "age" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "appearance" TEXT NOT NULL, "background" TEXT NOT NULL, "traits" TEXT NOT NULL, "habits" TEXT NOT NULL, "wants_needs_fears" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_void_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES void_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_characters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "character_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES characters (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "age" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NULL, "appearance" TEXT NULL, "background" TEXT NULL, "traits" TEXT NULL, "habits" TEXT NULL, "wants_needs_fears" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_characters_linked ON project_characters (project_id, character_id) WHERE mode = 'linked'
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "void_items_fts" USING fts5(summary, raw_transcript, content='void_items', content_rowid='rowid', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');
CREATE TRIGGER void_items_ai AFTER INSERT ON void_items BEGIN INSERT INTO void_items_fts ("rowid", summary, raw_transcript) VALUES (new."rowid", new.summary, new.raw_transcript);END

CREATE TRIGGER void_items_ad AFTER DELETE ON void_items BEGIN INSERT INTO void_items_fts (void_items_fts, "rowid", summary, raw_transcript) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.summary, old.raw_transcript);END

CREATE TRIGGER void_items_au AFTER UPDATE ON void_items BEGIN INSERT INTO void_items_fts (void_items_fts, "rowid", summary, raw_transcript) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.summary, old.raw_transcript);INSERT INTO void_items_fts ("rowid", summary, raw_transcript) VALUES (new."rowid", new.summary, new.raw_transcript);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shot_images" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("builtin" IN (0, 1)), "user_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_edited" IN (0, 1)), "seed_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "shot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shots (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "license" TEXT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_maps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nodes" TEXT NOT NULL, "edges" TEXT NOT NULL, "groups" TEXT NOT NULL, "viewport" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
